profile.campus: Aligned Dallas-Fort Worth campus (Plano, TX, also Aligned North American headquarters)

source.basis: Operator location page, structured facts only, no operator prose reproduced.

profile.reading: Aligned DFW-01 sits at 2800 Summit Avenue in Plano, Texas, the original building on Aligned Data Centers 19-acre Dallas-Fort Worth flagship campus, which the operator own location page states now also serves as Aligned North American headquarters. The facility was built to a Tier III design standard, per Aligned own materials, and the Dallas-Fort Worth market was where the company established its earliest operations before expanding to Ashburn, Chicago, Phoenix, Hillsboro, and other US markets. No dedicated press release describing DFW-01 specifically, its capacity in megawatts, or its square footage could be located this session, a gap in Aligned own published materials for what appears to be an earlier-generation building predating the company more recent practice of issuing detailed groundbreaking and topping-out releases for each new facility. That gap is noted honestly here rather than filled with a figure carried over from the newer DFW-02 building on the same campus, since capacities across Aligned campus buildings vary considerably. Aligned, formerly known as Aligned Energy, describes its overall footprint today as more than fifty campuses and roughly five gigawatts of contracted and available capacity across the Americas, with Latin American operations run under the ODATA brand. Ownership has shifted substantially over the company history, most recently with an October 2025 agreement for a consortium called AI Infrastructure Partnership, combining BlackRock Global Infrastructure Partners and MGX, to acquire all of Aligned equity from majority owner Macquarie Asset Management and its co-investors in a deal valued near 40 billion dollars, with a close indicated around July 2026 in Aligned own materials though not independently confirmed by a dedicated press release this session.
profile.research_note: Operator page confirms address (2800 Summit Ave, Plano TX 75074), "Tier III" design standard, 19-acre campus, 100% uptime SLA, but publishes no building sqft, IT capacity MW, certifications, year built, or generator MW.

reading.body:
Aligned DFW-01 is the original building on Aligned's 19-acre Dallas-Fort Worth flagship campus and serves as Aligned North American headquarters. It was built to Tier III design standard, qualifying it for non-redundant cooling and power distribution typical of colocation infrastructure. The operator publishes no megawatt capacity, square footage, or year-built date for this facility, a gap in disclosure that distinguishes it from Aligned's newer campuses, which issue detailed capacity announcements.

Texas has 133 mapped data center facilities, of which 18 operators have published megawatt figures totaling 468 MW. DFW-01 does not contribute a published figure to that total. This campus cannot be ranked among Texas facilities by capacity until its IT load is disclosed.

Aligned operates more than fifty North American campuses with roughly five gigawatts of contracted and available capacity across the Americas. The company was recently subject to an announced acquisition by AI Infrastructure Partnership, a consortium of BlackRock Global Infrastructure Partners and MGX, in a deal valued near forty billion dollars with a close indicated around July 2026, though the transaction is not independently confirmed by a dedicated press release this session.
